content: Does not start. Lid not closed; water taps closed; START/PAUSE not pressed; Child Lock activated; lid opened during the spinning cycle; fuse blown or circuit breaker tripped. Clicking noises before filling and a Standby or soaking cycle are normal. 1. Make sure the lid is closed. 2. Make sure the water taps are open. 3. Make sure to press START/PAUSE to start the washing machine. 4. Make sure Child Lock is not activated. 5. Before the washing machine starts to fill, it will make a series of clicking noises to check if the lid is locked, and does a quick drain. 6. Was the lid opened during the spinning cycle? content: Stops. Power cord not plugged into a live outlet; fuse blown or circuit breaker tripped; lid not closed or START/PAUSE not pressed; inlet hose screens at the taps clogged; low voltage. A pause or soak period in the cycle and clicking noises before filling are normal. 1. Plug the power cord into a live electrical outlet. 2. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker. 3. Close the lid, and press START/PAUSE to start the washing machine. For your safety, the washing machine will not spin unless the lid is closed. 4. Before the washing machine starts to fill, it will make a series of clicking noises to check if the lid is locked, and does a quick drain. 5. There may be a pause or soak period in the cycle. Wait briefly and the washing machine may start. 6. Make sure the inlet hose screens at the taps are not clogged. Periodically clean the screens. 7. This problem occurs temporarily due to low voltages, and will be solved when power recovers.

content: Fills with the wrong temperature water. Water taps not fully open; wrong temperature selection; hoses connected to the wrong water taps; hose filter screens clogged. Temperature changes during filling are a normal function of the automatic temperature control. 1. Fully open both water taps. 2. Make sure the temperature selection is correct. 3. Make sure the hoses are connected to the correct water taps. Flush water lines. 4. Disconnect the hoses and clean the screens. The hose filter screens may be clogged. 5. While the washing machine fills, the water temperature may change as the automatic temperature control feature checks incoming water temperature. This is normal. 6. While the washing machine fills, you may notice just hot and/or just cold water going through the dispenser when cold or warm temperatures are selected. This is a normal function of the automatic temperature control feature as the washing machine determines the water temperature.

content: Leaks water. Hose connections loose; water supply hose rubber packing out of position; drain hose end not correctly inserted and secured; overloading; non-HE detergent causing oversudsing; water supply hose kinked; water supply too strong; leak from the water tap. 1. Make sure all hose connections are tight. 2. Make sure the water supply hose's rubber packing is in the correct position. Screw tightly again. 3.
